The useEffect has a lint-disable comment for exhaustive-deps because intentionally only tracking debouncedSearch to avoid infinite loops. (5) useDebouncedValue.ts and .test.ts staged as B9-session files (SearchFilters imports useDebouncedValue). (6) VehiclesTab.tsx has no 409 guard toasts — vehicle CRUD does not use map409ErrorToKey; spec does not require 409 handling for vehicles, only for staff deactivation.
